title: add persistent LambdaTest run artifacts
description: Enhance lt_run_cmd with persistent per-run/per-device artifact downloads. Keep output.txt built in; support repeatable traversal-safe relative --artifact-path uploads and --require-artifact-glob local validation; add --artifacts-dir; reject duplicate device serials before launch; report artifact paths and per-device validation failures. Keep scheduler/concurrency behavior unchanged. Verify HyperExecute recursive glob support in a smoke task; if unsupported, upload the artifact directory while retaining recursive local validation.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with a live HyperExecute artifact-glob smoke run.

comments.author: aerickson
comments.text: Implemented CLI artifact directory, opt-in upload and required-glob flags, per-device persistence, duplicate serial rejection, report/log paths, and focused tests. Local verification: ruff passes and 103 tests pass. Full suite has 6 pre-existing/configuration-dependent EOF errors in test_run_manager_lt_test.py. A live HyperExecute smoke run remains needed to confirm recursive ** upload-glob support; fall back to uploading fleetbench-artifacts directory if unsupported.

comments.author: aerickson
comments.text: Live HyperExecute smoke run confirmed recursive ** artifact upload support: extra-artifact-1 completed and downloaded fleetbench-artifacts/nested/result.json. Fixed required-glob validation to account for HyperExecute nesting downloaded payloads under <artifact-name>/<attempt>/. Added regression coverage for that layout.

title: detect LambdaTest devices busy without active jobs
description: Add a LambdaTest CLI report that compares API busy device states with active console jobs by device UDID, reporting busy devices that have no matching running or initiated job.
